prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: source sheet for a small transparent animated icon on a fashion workflow website
Primary request: Make one square 2x2 sheet of EXACTLY four equal square panels, showing four sequential motion phases of the SAME two premium miniature white-clay paper garment pattern pieces. The two softly dimensional paper pattern pieces sit apart, then slide toward one another, align their curved edges and notches precisely, and return slightly toward the start to form a seamless loop. Include tiny tactile paper notches and faint seam allowance marks, but no readable markings. Clearly depict pattern making and piece alignment.
Scene/backdrop: nothing behind the objects; transparent.
Subject: exactly two recognizable pale paper garment pattern pieces, a bodice front and sleeve-like panel, repeated consistently in each tile.
Style/medium: charming premium softly rounded white-clay/paper 3D miniature icon; tactile matte paper, subtle pale neutral-grey depth and shadow; refined fashion illustration, sophisticated and friendly, not line art.
Composition/framing: fixed camera; same scale, perspective, lighting and tile composition; objects centered with ample transparent margin inside each equal square; exact 2x2 tiles with no dividers.
Lighting/mood: clean diffused studio lighting, subtle contact shadows.
Color palette: white and pale neutral grey only, transparent alpha.
Materials/textures: lightly textured cut paper with softly rounded edges and delicately embossed seam allowance.
Text (verbatim): none.
Constraints: exactly the same pair of pattern pieces in all four panels, positions change only in the described slide-and-align motion; true transparent background.
Avoid: colors, beige, black backdrop, text, labels, numbers, ruler, scissors, people, watermark, visible grid, panel borders, frame, changing camera, inconsistent design, cropped objects, crude vector line drawing.
